verdict.rationale: Mem0 documents an official hosted MCP server that lets any MCP-capable client (Claude, Cursor, etc.) connect to a shared memory store with a single command, plus dedicated integration guides for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other harnesses, and 22+ SDK integrations for other tools/apps — all pointing at the same underlying memory store scoped by user/agent/app. This directly supports the cross-tool shared-memory story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that multiple different off-the-shelf assistants simultaneously sharing one memory store actually works smoothly in practice (community evidence only discusses general memory quality/skepticism, not this specific multi-client scenario).
